name: Alistair Campbell
bio:
Alistair Campbell's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly, trading sheep farming for speed after a chance encounter with a local racing team. His sharp mind and pragmatic approach quickly saw him rise through the ranks, initially as a mechanic before transitioning into management. He believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement, rigorously analyzing every aspect of the team's performance to identify marginal gains. 

Alistair's meticulous nature and calm demeanor belie a burning ambition to see Racing Start Academy reach its full potential. He's known for his ability to remain composed even under immense pressure, earning him the respect of his colleagues. He has a habit of using analogies from his farming days to explain complex engineering issues, which, while sometimes humorous, always gets the point across. 

His distinctive ability to blend technical expertise with strong leadership skills makes him an invaluable asset to the team. Alistair's dedication to precision and his unwavering belief in the power of collective effort drive Racing Start Academy towards success.

physical.description: Alistair is a solidly built man with a weathered face that speaks of years spent outdoors.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations.
Has a framed picture of a sheep in his office.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout the day.
